scope: Original synthetic workflow acceptance inputs and independent exact rational references; not measured or published literature data. Frozen engine bytes, original catalog records/metadata, and locale values preserve implementation/evidence states while permitting unrelated catalog/label appends and additional evidence on catalog-only claims when every original evidence entry and its relative order remain unchanged. Eight executable claims and all original source records stay fully pinned. This is not scientific verification.

provenance.note: Original workflow acceptance fixture; no actual material, measured data, or literature parameters.

scenarios.title: Phase pairing and mixed units
scenarios.decision: unchanged values for complete-record reversal; 12000 MPa for A bulk and 18000000000 Pa for B shear reproduce A01. MPa output scales K/G/E by 1000; ν remains unchanged in unit 1.

scenarios.title: Equal bulk moduli
scenarios.decision: all eight S; bulk endpoints collapse to 12, but unequal shear leaves a nonzero HS shear interval and generally nonzero E/ν envelopes.

scenarios.title: Equal shear moduli
scenarios.decision: all eight S; shear collapses to 6; HS bulk also collapses to 336/13 GPa, while bulk Reuss=24 and Voigt=30 remain distinct. E/ν envelopes collapse.

scenarios.title: Identical phases
scenarios.decision: all eight S, K=12, G=6, E=108/7 GPa and ν=2/7 for every declared fraction pair, including endpoints.

scenarios.title: Pure phase with an absent record
scenarios.decision: fractions 1/0 with B K/G null give all eight S and the A-only values from A05. Removing B's record yields V for all eight. A malformed B unit still causes structural error even at zero fraction.

scenarios.title: Tiny positive is active
scenarios.decision: with A fraction 1 and B fraction 1e-299, B remains active; missing B K/G gives U for all eight. Numerical normalization is not permission to set B to zero.

scenarios.title: Negative and zero Poisson ratios
scenarios.decision: identical K=2,G=6 gives ν=−0.25 and E=9 GPa; identical K=4,G=6 gives ν=0 and E=12 GPa. All eight S in both cases.

scenarios.title: Unknown effective isotropy
scenarios.decision: null or omitted effective_symmetry gives U for all eight; valid input, no numeric bounds.

scenarios.title: Unknown shear in a bulk-only question
scenarios.decision: all eight U under this implementation, including Reuss/Voigt bulk.

scenarios.title: Missing fractions and mass fractions
scenarios.decision: a missing B volume fraction stays unknown and all eight U. Mass fractions are unsupported data for this field; entering a mass_fraction key is invalid input.

scenarios.title: Crossed K and G ordering
scenarios.decision: A=(12,18), B=(36,6): HS K/G and E/ν are V. Four Reuss/Voigt rows are S: K lower/upper=24/30, G lower/upper=7.2/9 GPa.

scenarios.title: Isotropic aggregate of anisotropic constituents
scenarios.decision: constituent_symmetry=anisotropic gives V for all eight even if effective_symmetry=isotropic.

scenarios.title: Known violation and missing data coexist
scenarios.decision: V for all eight, retaining dynamic-loading violation and missing-shear unknown checks.

scenarios.title: Unsupported regimes and phase counts
scenarios.decision: independently test each unsupported condition and one-/three-phase descriptions: all eight V when the overall input is structurally valid. A 2D N/m modulus is structurally rejected as an unsupported unit.

scenarios.title: Active void or negative stiffness
scenarios.decision: zero/negative active K or G is structurally valid but V for all eight.

scenarios.title: Invalid data stays invalid
scenarios.decision: each variant rejects before evaluation with invalid_input and exit 2; no result report is created. Unknown/null is distinct from invalid type/units/nonfinite/lexically-underflowed data.

scenarios.title: Fraction tolerance and disclosure
scenarios.decision: A=0.2500000000002/B=0.75 is accepted and normalized, all eight S. A=0.250000000002/B=0.75 exceeds tolerance and rejects with exit 2.

scenarios.title: Output overflow and underflow
scenarios.decision: all K/G=1e307 GPa requested in Pa gives eight N. All K/G=1e-323 Pa requested in GPa also gives eight N. In a representable unit some/all results may recover, but each rule must be reevaluated.

scenarios.title: Poisson boundary rounding
scenarios.decision: first seven results S; ν alone N. Reverse the scale, K=2,G=1e90: likewise reject the float endpoint at −1.

scenarios.title: Exact large-integer phase ordering
scenarios.decision: keep exact input integers 10^110 and 10^110+3. HS/E/ν are V; four Reuss/Voigt rows S.

scenarios.title: Raw model E and ν are not effective outputs
scenarios.decision: a structurally complete imported literature_model contract checks K/G consistency against the fixed conversion: 14/8.4 and 56/33.6 in E's unit. Inconsistent derived K/G, mismatched phase/source IDs, missing model_evidence or wrong condition bases reject. Conversion alone never proves measurement or source truth.

scenarios.title: Measured-input provenance does not verify a sample
scenarios.decision: valid measured provenance can still produce the same conditional numerical outputs; no physical sample, temperature, grade, cure state or uncertainty is thereby verified.

scenarios.title: An experimental value inside or outside an interval
scenarios.decision: neither conclusion follows automatically. This milestone has no measured-composite comparison or uncertainty input API. Check measurement definitions, constituent values, units, fractions, all model premises, uncertainty and numerical policy before any same-assumption scientific comparison.

scenarios.title: Derived envelope is not a joint attainable design
scenarios.decision: no joint attainability is established. E/ν are outer envelopes from the same two marginal HS intervals; different corners need not share any realizable microstructure.

scenarios.title: Honest formula citations and review limits
scenarios.decision: identify the recorded gaps. HS 1963 has no inspected original equation locator/proof; Reuss has a standard expression with contextual support; the E/ν envelope is a project derivation. Meille–Garboczi identity evidence is recorded as text-checked with visual verification incomplete.

scenarios.title: User citation cannot manufacture evidence
scenarios.decision: engine results can still compute under supplied assumptions; the report records that input citation as unresolved and unverified. The fixed formula citations are unaffected.

scenarios.title: Four-language semantic parity
scenarios.decision: identical canonical JSON, endpoints, units, IDs, dependency graph, statuses and gaps for all four languages. Human labels differ; source titles and user text retain original wording.

scenarios.title: Replay detects altered or stale bundles
scenarios.decision: unchanged bundle reproduces with matching engine/catalog contract. Independently modify an endpoint, unit, condition, fraction, root/nested instance ID, dependency, rule ID, review flag, source locator/gap, policy or version: replay fails closed as altered/stale. Schema shape alone is insufficient.

scenarios.title: Local export and interrupted intake
scenarios.decision: no code executes, no network request/upload occurs, no unrelated file is overwritten, and no partial result is presented as success. Cancel/back/edit preserve or discard the user's draft explicitly; rerunning does not silently reuse stale outputs.
